Professional Relationship

  • CURIE: gmeow:ProfessionalRelationship
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProfessionalRelationship
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/contacts
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

An interpersonal relationship arising from work — colleagues, collaborators, a client and a provider (the reified form of hasWorkedWith).

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:ProfessionalRelationship as a specialized kind of gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use as the reified form of gmeow:hasWorkedWith — a working tie between agents that must carry its own interval, confidence, or evidence.

Avoid when

  • Avoid it for the bare symmetric fact (use gmeow:hasWorkedWith) and for a purely social tie (use gmeow:AcquaintanceRelationship).

How to use

  • Mint the relator, bind its agents with gmeow:relationshipParty, and carry its span with gmeow:relationshipInterval; it inherits the at-least-one-party axiom from gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship.

Examples

  • ex:collab a gmeow:ProfessionalRelationship; gmeow:relationshipParty ex:lillith, ex:morgan.
